g.title: ESP32
g.text: ESP32 devboard (ESP-WROOM-32, USB-C), in a socket on the carrier
USB = micro-ROS link (UART0, 921600). GPIO36 battery ADC and GPIO39 rain: unused. GPIO2 status LED.

g.title: HCT245
g.text: 74HCT245 buffer at 5 V, DIP-20 in a socket
3.3 V in, 5 V out for the driver optocouplers

g.title: DRV_L
g.text: ENA is not driven by the firmware yet

g.title: BLD
g.text: speed from its own pot ?; EN level and polarity ?

g.title: BLADE
g.text: shaft diameter ?; printed disc on a flange coupling (to buy)

g.title: J_GNSS
g.text: 20 pins, 4 used. Must also take another RTK board later.

g.title: C94
g.text: 3.3 V UART, 19200. Pin 20 RADIO_OFF left open.

g.title: IMU
g.text: ICM-42688-P module, on headers on the carrier

g.title: INA226
g.text: INA226 module, on headers on the carrier, 2 mOhm shunt
pack voltage and current, same I2C bus as the IMU

g.title: TOF_L
g.text: JST-XH 6 soldered into the header holes

g.title: TOF_R
g.text: JST-XH 6 soldered into the header holes

g.title: BUCK
g.text: 24 V to 5 V 10 A buck, potted

g.title: ESTOP
g.text: in the + line or on the driver enables: open

g.title: CHARGE
g.text: 29.4 V 2 A charger comes with the pack
